body: Meet the Four Peaks Overlander, a fully customized Mercedes Sprinter 170 EXT AWD camper van designed for those who crave off-road adventure and off-grid freedom. Built by us here at Papago Vans, this rugged rig combines unmatched off-road capability with the comfort and style of a luxury home on wheels, making it the ultimate choice for van life enthusiasts and overlanding adventurers.

The Four Peaks Overlander is equipped with a powerful 400W solar system, 800Ah lithium battery, and a 3000W pure sine wave inverter, delivering reliable energy for extended journeys. Its Agile Off Road Lift Kit, all-terrain tires, and Backwoods front and rear bumpers with integrated lighting make it a beast on any terrain, while the Warn 12s winch and exterior perimeter lighting add an extra layer of capability and safety for remote expeditions.

Step inside and discover a meticulously crafted interior that balances function and luxury. The modern kitchen features a double burner induction cooktop, Furrion oven, and Isotherm Cruise 130 refrigerator, providing everything you need to prepare gourmet meals on the road. Outdoor cooking is elevated with the Blackstone Griddle Package and collapsible table, perfect for enjoying meals with panoramic views of nature.

When it’s time to unwind, the Four Peaks Overlander has you covered with a tiled wet-bath shower, Laveo Dry Flush Toilet, and a queen-size memory foam bed for ultimate comfort. Stay connected wherever you roam with Starlink satellite internet, and enjoy versatile sleeping options with the Roofnest Falcon 3 Evo rooftop tent for extra capacity.

The interior design combines rugged elegance and practicality, featuring smoke gray-stained wood ceilings, painted shiplap walls, and dimmable LED lighting for a cozy ambiance. Storage is ample, with six overhead cabinets, under-counter storage, and a headliner shelf for all your gear.

The Four Peaks Overlander isn’t just a camper van; it’s a gateway to exploration. Whether you’re navigating mountain trails, desert landscapes, or secluded campsites, this van is built to take you there with confidence and style.
Contact Papago Vans today to start your journey with a custom van designed for adventure, freedom, and the open road!
